scientific_scope_status: For a finite undirected signed multigraph with n vertices, m>=1 edges, edge signs in F2 and explicitly supplied independent rational retention probabilities p_e, the source proposes a relative-error FPRAS for U=Pr[retained graph contains an odd-sign cycle]. Total probability encoding length B is charged. Initially 0<p_e<1; deterministic endpoint handling and negative loops/parallel edges are described on page 7. A balanced full graph is detected separately as U=0. This is an internally derived, unreviewed proof candidate, not a demonstrated approximation implementation.
